answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 38862 Country: India Title: Can we give some person money to buy cloth for us and then sell him the same cloth at higher rate as he will pay after one month Question: Can we give some person money to buy cloth for us and then sell him the same cloth at higher rate as he will pay after one month? Answer ID: 38862 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 494/473/N=1433) The concerned person in the question first should buy cloth for you from your money and then you shall sell those clothes to him with some profit on loan with fixed price then as per the Shariah this dealing shall be lawful and correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
